note: Video upscale: the official 'Video Upscale: Real-ESRGAN' graph (LoadVideo, GetVideoComponents, ImageUpscaleWithModel with RealESRGAN_x4plus, CreateVideo keeping the clip's frame rate and sound, SaveVideo) plus one core ImageScale after the model. The model always enlarges 4x; ImageScale lands that on the size asked for (width and height, even numbers because the video is yuv420p). 'area' averages when the picture is shrunk, which is nearly every case; 'bicubic' is for a target above 4x the clip, where 'area' does not interpolate and the picture would turn blocky. The clip is held in memory at 4x before the resize.
